gen-fs-quilon-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible: Quilon swells and thins in a slow, restrained rhythm, its tall a, e and s opening wide. Atkinson Hyperlegible sits beneath it, plain and approachable.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-m: Soft as brushed watercolor, Quilon shifts its line weight so quietly you barely catch it. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono lines up below, every letter given room.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-n: Quilon carries an editorial confidence, with hairlines a touch thinner than you'd expect. Atkinson Hyperlegible Next follows in sans-serif form, its big lowercase eyes and unlatched rounds keeping a long page easy going.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-biryani: Biryani draws like a pencil line, steady and clear. Quilon above it brings thins that never turn spindly, so the heading stays commanding while the sans-serif text underneath keeps every small counter open.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-blinker: Quilon's strokes shift weight like brushed watercolor, quiet but unmistakably editorial in feel. Blinker answers in a single pen-tip line, and that plain sans simplicity is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-carrois-gothic: Quilon brings a commanding, editorial voice, with a moderate contrast between its strokes and wide open a, e and s. And Carrois Gothic, with its high x-height, leaves the heading to do the big, short work.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Carrois Gothic SC keeps capitals and lowercase nearly the same height, with every curve ending in a clear opening. Quilon's stems run a touch heavier than its crossbars, and that is the pair's quiet strength.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-cascadia-code: Commanding and editorial, Quilon rises with a moderate stem-to-hairline ratio. Cascadia Code, a plain sans of wire-like monoline, would be happiest at a modest size beneath it.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-cascadia-mono: Editorial in mood, Quilon ebbs and flows through a noticeable but modest thick-thin difference. Cascadia Mono stands its letters like pins in a wide board, so a long page reads with a steady, compact tick.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-chivo: Quilon finds a comfortable midpoint between flat strokes and dramatic ones, with large open counters in tall a, e and s. Chivo, a plain sans, simply packs its lowercase up toward the caps and lets daylight through every curve.
